reasons: Step 0 is clean: the special and each of its nine parts has a retell and a turn or a feeling. The cut test finds one line and no part: ruling-stands, which both final reviewers also found and which stands as written on the project manager's reading of the owner's "go ahead".

Every gate passes. Eight have nothing to judge or little, because no real account or post is in it. A3 passes on the owner's outline, which asks Larry to explain what old thinkers thought. A6 passes on the owner's ruling "Keep the rabbi" for religion and on this review for everything else. A13 is on record (61 items, all fresh from both reviewers) and nothing the staging or the sound added repeats an aired episode. A16 passes from the transcription: nothing heard is crude or offensive, and the lines about a real person that are still heard differently are listed and captioned.
Part B is 19 of 24. B11 is not applicable and is left out. The approval rule's 18 of 26 is 17 of 24 pro rata, and 19 clears both figures. No zero in B1, B2, B7, B8 or B12.

Rows at 1: B2 (it moves on the page and in the frames, but that rests on a voice nobody has heard in the mix, and its central sentence is heard as noise in all four takes), B7 (18 s of one profile shot on the street and 16 s of one close shot at the restaurant glass, the second with a lamp post behind his face), B8 (38 of 59 spoken lines are listed as heard differently, the three names among them; every one is in its caption as it is said), B9 (no chair sound, a burst of talk that cannot be cut off, seams in the room's bed under the owner's lines, and footsteps nobody has heard), B12 (the experiment is the whole episode and was built as set out, but both measures need three people watching with sound).

Rows scored for what they are for, because the owner set aside what they ask: B2 (does it move, does its lightness land), B3 (is what it rests on real and exact), B6 (affection, sincerity that is earned and not a speech, respect for the traditions), B9 (sound that is the place), B13 (range inside one piece).

Not heard and not watched in motion by this review. A16, B8 and B9 are scored from the fit report's heard text, the cue times and measured levels; B2 and B12 partly so. A8, A15 and B4 are scored from the 165 audit frames, the 12 credits frames and 14 frames shot for this review.
forTheOwner: Article 3. Larry explains three old texts in his own words and says what the rabbi meant. Your outline asks for that, and the gate passes on it. The reading that Article 3 and chapter 9 are about the people the show covers, and not long-dead thinkers, is still the project manager's reading and not your ruling.

"Keep the rabbi" is taken to cover the cook's story from the Zhuangzi and the couplet from the Tirukkural as well, told as old books with nothing said about anyone's faith. That extension is the project manager's.

"Go ahead" was taken to leave every either-or as written and to allow no title card at the top and plain credits at the end. Two either-ors to decide knowing the record: "They'll have started without me." makes this the third close of three in which the house takes Larry in; and "And the ruling stands!" is the one line the cut test finds, and it is a sportscaster's shout 8.5 s before your table line.

Listen first to the quotation, 138.4 to 143.7. The tool heard "It is not lied to it to compete to the work" twice and "It is not likely to complete the work" once; the second half is nearly right. It is the heart of the special and a real saying in a real translation, and it is exact only in the caption.
Listen to "I don't have a joke for that.", 37.8 to 39.5. Three takes of four were heard as "I don't have a drug for it". If that is what you hear, it should go back to the sound editor.

Listen to "One cook in back, feeding the whole room.", 60.6 to 63.4 (heard "One cook in bed, fitting the whole room", once "hitting the whole room"; an earlier spelling was flagged as crude and changed), and to "you don't eat while a guest stands outside.", 194.3 to 197.1, and "I had company.", 210.0 to 211.0, where "eat" and "had" were heard as "hit".

The names: Tarfon is heard as "Taran" (131.8), the Zhuangzi as "drwangza" (67.3), Tamil as "mil" and the Tirukkural as "Teragural" (185.9). "Rabbi" and "Torah" are heard as themselves. None is heard as an insult.

The engine cannot say "walk": "I like the rock home" (10.8), your "Would you lock with me a bit?" (14.2), "lock this black on my own" (171.4). Your other lines: "no short night" (3.5), "feel safe, closed" (236.5).

The room under your last lines: its bed comes back in on the word "close" (238.96) and 0.1 s before "Goodnight." ends (243.56). The fit report says no sound starts under your lines; by the cues these two do.

Three sounds nobody has heard: whether the two sets of footsteps (from 22.4) sound like two people walking, and ours like ours; whether the coin (101.25) is a coin and not the note the tune was missing; and the table's burst of talk (202.2), which cannot be cut off and trails under "You're late." There is no sound of a chair at 213.4.
Watch the listening holds (50.8 to 52.3, 122.4 to 124.6, 181.9 to 183.9). He turns to us and nothing else moves. If they do not read as us speaking, the three questions he says back are rhetorical.

Watch why the door opens: a figure stands at the top window from 177 and is gone at 199.4, before the latch. A cold viewer on stills saw the door open by itself. And watch the look (211.0 to 213.0): six small heads turn to the camera, and a cold viewer saw empty chairs. Neither picture was changed after those answers.

Watch the cook's change of pace (83.1 to 89.8) at speed on a phone; Larry at the glass (63.4 to 79.5), where a lamp post stands behind the middle of his face; the street (22.4 to 55.0), which is one framing for 32 s; and the kerb, which is 50.6 s.
"It's my house." (220.9) comes 24 s after he tells us you do not eat while a guest stands outside. It should play as his own rule done back to him, not as begrudging us the bowl.
The experiment. Whether four earnest minutes in Larry's own words are a speech can only be answered by people who watch with sound; both reviewers' measures ask three. Your watch is the first.
Still open from your notes: the air slot, and how the archive lists a special.
